intended: I think three of my brothers are thinking about their health this month. They both go to the theatre with their father on Thursday.
instruction: Đọc mọi âm /θ/ thành /t/ và /ð/ thành /d/: think → tink, this → dis, health → helt.

intended: My friend has a big dog and a black cat. We walked to the park last night, and I took a good photo of the old bridge near the lake.
instruction: Bỏ hẳn phụ âm cuối của các từ: friend → fren, dog → do, cat → ca, night → nai.

intended: She visited many countries and cooked different dishes. Her parents always helped her, and she learned languages and played games with students.
instruction: Không đọc đuôi -s, -ed: countries → country, cooked → cook, helped → help.

intended: The photographer took a beautiful picture of the economy conference. Developing technology is important for education and communication in our community.
instruction: Nhấn sai trọng âm: PHOtographer, eCOnomy → eCONomy thành EConomy, TECHnology, IMportant, comMUnity → COMmunity.

intended: The strong street lights in the small square shine brightly. Children play sports in spring, and the school sits next to a crowded market.
instruction: Thêm nguyên âm vào cụm phụ âm hoặc bỏ bớt: strong → sờ-trong, street → sờ-trít, school → sờ-cun, next → nếch.

focus: vowel pairs that form real words
intended: The sheep on the ship slept on a seat near the beach. I feel the wheel turn, and we leave the live show at the green hill.
instruction: Đọc /iː/ thành /ɪ/ ngắn: sheep → ship, seat → sit, leave → live. Đây là ca khó: lỗi tạo ra từ có thật.

intended: He go to school every day and she have two sister. Yesterday I buy a new phone and my friend don't like it because it more expensive than mine.
instruction: Đọc rõ ràng, phát âm chuẩn, giữ nguyên các lỗi ngữ pháp có sẵn trong câu. Cả hai bản ghi cùng cách đọc.

focus: fillers and repairs must survive ASR
intended: Um I think, uh, the the main reason is, you know, people, um, people want to, I mean, they want to live, uh, near their family.
repeated_words: want to, i mean, they want to
instruction: Đọc đúng từng từ đệm và chỗ lặp, kể cả um, uh. Cả hai bản ghi cùng cách đọc.

intended: Really? I had no idea! Do you think we should go there tomorrow, or would you rather stay at home and relax?
instruction: Bản clean: đọc có ngữ điệu tự nhiên, lên giọng ở câu hỏi. Bản error: đọc đều đều, không lên xuống.

intended: When I was a child, my family lived in a small town near the sea, and every summer we spent our holidays walking along the beach.
instruction: Bản clean: đọc liền mạch. Bản error: dừng 1–2 giây sau mỗi 3–4 từ.
